api.name: BluetoothLowEnergyPlugin
api.docs: Capacitor Bluetooth Low Energy Plugin for BLE communication.

methods.name: initialize

tags.name: returns
tags.text: Promise that resolves when initialization is complete

methods.docs:
Initialize the BLE plugin.
Must be called before any other method.

methods.name: shimWebBluetooth
methods.docs:
Install the Capacitor Web Bluetooth shim on `navigator.bluetooth`.
Call this manually before using the Web Bluetooth API from a Capacitor native app.

properties.name: mode
properties.docs:
The mode to initialize the plugin in.
- 'central': Act as a BLE central (client)
- 'peripheral': Act as a BLE peripheral (server)

properties.name: showPowerAlert
properties.docs: Whether iOS should show the system Bluetooth power alert when Bluetooth is off (iOS only).

properties.name: available
properties.docs: Whether Bluetooth is available on the device.

properties.name: enabled
properties.docs: Whether Bluetooth is enabled on the device.

properties.name: enabled
properties.docs: Whether location services are enabled on the device.

interfaces.name: PermissionStatus
interfaces.docs: Permission status for Bluetooth and location.

properties.name: services
properties.docs:
List of service UUIDs to filter by.
Only devices advertising these services will be returned.

properties.name: timeout
properties.docs:
Scan timeout in milliseconds.
Set to 0 for no timeout.

properties.name: allowDuplicates
properties.docs: Whether to allow duplicate scan results.

interfaces.name: ConnectOptions
interfaces.docs: Options for connecting to a device.

properties.name: deviceId
properties.docs: The device ID (MAC address on Android, UUID on iOS).

properties.name: autoConnect
properties.docs: Whether to automatically connect when the device becomes available.

interfaces.name: DisconnectOptions

properties.name: deviceId
properties.docs: The device ID to disconnect from.

properties.name: deviceId
properties.docs: The device ID to discover services on.

properties.docs: Whether the characteristic supports write without response.

properties.docs: Whether the characteristic supports authenticated signed writes.

properties.name: extendedProperties

properties.name: deviceId
properties.docs: The device ID to get services for.

properties.name: deviceId

properties.docs: The device name (may be null if not available).

properties.name: value
properties.docs: The value to write as an array of bytes.

properties.name: name
properties.docs:
The device name to advertise.

On Android, advertising the local name is implemented by temporarily setting the Bluetooth adapter name
while advertising, then restoring the previous adapter name when advertising is stopped.

properties.name: includeName
properties.docs: Whether to include the device name in the advertisement.

properties.name: includeTxPowerLevel
properties.docs: Whether to include TX power level in the advertisement.
